items.statement: The submitted workflow validates minima and transition structures with frequencies and preserves chemical identity/connectivity for each state.
items.expected: Each claimed minimum has zero imaginary frequencies, each claimed transition structure has exactly one imaginary frequency associated with the stated event, and state-level identity/connectivity evidence is retained.

items.statement: The radical carbonylation sequence has three reported activation barriers and three relative reaction energies.
items.expected: The report gives barriers for CO addition, iodine transfer, and amine attack, plus relative energies for the acyl radical, acyl iodide, and final amide, with identities and kcal/mol units.

items.statement: The four amines are compared using both activation barrier and tetrahedral-intermediate free energy.
items.expected: The report contains separate barrier and intermediate ΔG values for aniline, N-ethylaniline, N-methylaniline, and morpholine, rather than inferring selectivity from barrier alone.
